change.reason: Propose the AIONix C IDE at the existing 19 May 1980 Artemis launch, removing its erroneous 1978 association; the separate Simple C Z80 offering remains the 1978 compiler. Migrate the previously undated network revision from version 2 to version 3 and insert the November option as version 2; no live record pins the old product version 2, and its snapshot is retained in review evidence. Keep COMDEX 1980 as an explained later demonstration. Shared launch/campaign records make these edits atomic. Also remove obsolete source-file wording and Academy purchase-credit/tuition wording from the affected launch and its process, following the instruction to keep commercial pricing outside this model. No event date, technical BOM target or authorization is invented.
